idea-plugin.name: Stage All Except Selected
idea-plugin.description:
Requires the Git staging area, which is off by default: enable it in Settings | Version Control | Git | Enable staging area.

Right-click one or more files in the staging area and choose Stage All Except Selected to stage every other modified or unversioned file. The selected files stay unstaged.

  • Selecting a folder keeps every file under it unstaged.
  • A partially staged file whose unstaged entry is selected keeps its unstaged changes.
  • Unversioned files are staged like modified ones, as Stage All does.
  • Conflicted and ignored files are never staged.
  • Files are staged in every Git repository shown in the staging area.

Free and open source under the MIT License. Source code and the issue tracker are on GitHub.
